meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub 拉取请求自动转为代码变更讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果开发时需要为代码变更快速生成讲解视频。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a GitHub pull request into a code-change explainer video automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create explainer videos for code changes from pull requests.

howto.what: 装上该技能后，Claude能将GitHub Pull Request自动转换为代码变更讲解视频，包括读取PR内容、理解代码变更、规划解说脚本并逐帧构建视频。
howto.when: 当用户提供一个GitHub PR的URL、owner/repo#N或说“this PR”并请求制作解释视频时触发。

say.note: Claude会读取PR并开始制作视频。

say.text: 为这个PR生成变更说明视频
say.note: Claude会基于PR的diff、提交等信息规划视频。
Claude会分析PR并产出解说视频。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can automatically turn a GitHub Pull Request into a code-change explainer video: it reads the PR, understands the change, plans a script, and builds the video frame by frame.
howto.when_en: When a user provides a GitHub PR reference (URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR') and asks for an explainer video.

say_en.text: Turn this PR into a video explainer.
say_en.note: Claude will read the PR and start building.

say_en.text: Generate a change-explainer video for this PR.
say_en.note: Claude will use the diff, commits, etc.

say_en.text: Explain the code changes in this PR.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and produce a video.
